description: A vertex list ([[x,y],… metre pairs) — receives vertices and republishes them. Draws nothing.
instructions:
A pure VALUE node for a vertex list: it receives vertices on `valin-points` and republishes them on `val-points`. It draws NOTHING on the canvas and emits no Space — wire it into a Polygon node when you want the list drawn.

Use it to carry an outline between operations, e.g. Space Geometry → Vertices → Inset (`valin-polygon`), or Vertices → Polygon.

A wired list overrides the typed one; with nothing wired the typed list is published as-is, so it also works as a standalone coordinate source.
